changelog:
Initial release of Stock Analyst skill with deep technical and fundamental analysis for US, Malaysia, and Hong Kong markets:

- Supports automatic market/ticker detection with strict parsing rules (STIP).
- Integrates multi-source data: financial metrics, technical indicators, news, insider trades.
- Implements anti-hallucination checks: price/time validation, multi-source cross-checks, abnormal value alerts.
- Custom Telegram output with clear formatting and actionable trade levels.
- Mandates up-to-date, real-time data reporting with precise timestamps and source links.
summary: Perform detailed technical and fundamental analysis of US, Malaysia, and Hong Kong stocks with real-time data, news, and actionable trading levels.
